production.initial:
Use case: style-transfer / scientific-educational.
Create the replacement PRODUCTION teaching overview for the same Chinese petroleum course.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 (mudlogging) is the PRIMARY exact style reference: airy cream background, elegant clean miniature 3D/isometric cutaway, small orange-clad full-body technicians, soft pastel workstation zones and wide colorful flowing data ribbons. Image 2 (geology) is a secondary style reference for navy Chinese sans-serif captions and light blue/pastel title pills. Image 3 (geophysics) shows the five parallel workstations and source-to-evidence business organization. Image 4 is CONTENT REFERENCE ONLY, showing the old production subjects; do NOT imitate its dense poster styling, photographic realism, brown title banners or heavy boxes.
Rebuild the complete artwork to look as though the illustrator of Image 1 drew this new theme. Strongly favor Image1, NOT the old image4. Soft tiny scale models, smooth painted/resin materials and simplified friendly people, not photographs, no close-up faces. A near-white warm ivory background with extensive breathing room and faint distant scenery fading away. Light delicate shadows, restrained terrain detail; NO brown paper grain, no sepia wash, no dark brown brush titles, no giant title and no dense tables or text boards.
Composition: exactly 4:3, 1448x1086, one continuous illustration. Top y30..350: miniature oilfield slice on an open cream surface: a beam pump and rod-pump well at left, separate correctly shown electric submersible pump well in the center, blue water-injection well feeding reservoir layers, small separation/metering facilities toward the right. Tiny orange-uniform technicians. Short floating labels only: “举升采油”, “分离计量”, “注水补能”, “生产记录”. Show the physical relationship clearly, not a photorealistic landscape.
Across y445..760 arrange FIVE equal-width distinct freestanding miniature workstations, left to right occupying x0..288,290..578,580..868,870..1158,1160..1448. They must match the open workstations in Image1: small whole-body workers, physical devices and monitors on small pastel bases, with equipment larger than people. Soft colored zones (orange, sky blue, purple, green, teal), navy Chinese sans-serif headers on light pastel pills. Do not wrap them in thick framed dashboard cards.
Exact five short labels:
“P1 示功图诊断” — closed load-displacement loop on monitor, small beam-pump model, technician comparing shapes.
“P2 产量预测” — a measured history curve and dashed next segment on monitor, notebook.
“P3 注水调配” — miniature manifold branching to injectors, distribution bars under a shared budget, no claim of measured oil gain.
“P4 电潜泵监测” — a small electric pump cutaway and time traces of current/temperature/pressure.
“P5 结垢线索” — production choke cutaway with deposition beside pressure and temperature plots, no wax-identification claim.
Only one small explanatory line per station if necessary, no checklists. Keep headers fully inside the image with generous spacing.
Broad softly shaded color ribbons branch from shared production records ABOVE the five workstations and lead from the workstations down to the lower integrated outcome; they are parallel tasks, NOT a mandatory P1-to-P5 chain.
Bottom y820..1070: an elegant miniature production ledger and well map, small desks with orange-clad people reviewing records; no wall of text. Two short pastel captions “统一井号与时间” and “候选结果 → 工程复核 → 生产台账”. Keep this visually airy like Image1's lower combined log/report area.
Accurate major equipment relationships. All charts are conceptual teaching illustration; no invented performance percentages, no success guarantee, no actual dataset claims. No website controls, no UI toolbar, no watermark.
production.separateInjection: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached NEW production overview. Keep the entire visual style, ivory background, miniature scale, all five workstations, all Chinese labels, all lower desks and colored data ribbons exactly as they are. Change ONLY the surface piping in the TOP oilfield to clarify one engineering relation: the BLUE water-injection well in the upper center must be on an independent BLUE water supply line feeding downward into the reservoir. It MUST NOT be joined to the yellow/gold produced-oil collection pipeline going from the beam-pump/ESP production wells to the separator. Route the GOLD production collector unobtrusively behind the injection well with a visible gap from its blue wellhead; keep its direction toward the separator. Add only a tiny plain water supply tank/pump near the injection well if essential, connected by a blue line; short label “注入水”. Maintain all other composition, scale and 1448x1086 dimensions. No new large labels, no heavy frames, no photographic textures.
production.upwardProductionFlow: Precise scientific diagram edit. Preserve this entire supplied production teaching illustration exactly: same soft miniature/isometric style, same 1448x1086 canvas, colors, all Chinese labels, five workstations, lower records and all other arrows/pipes. Change ONLY ONE direction: inside the TOP CENTER-LEFT electric-submersible-pump production well beneath the RED wellhead (the well at about x480), the existing YELLOW vertical flow arrow must point UPWARD toward the red wellhead and then the GOLD surface production collector/separator. This is an oil-producing ESP well, so its produced-fluid arrow is upward, NOT downward. Keep the top-left beam-pump well's upward yellow arrow and the top-center BLUE injection well's downward BLUE water arrows unchanged. No new objects or text and no other visual/style changes.

workover.initial:
Use case: style-transfer / scientific-educational.
This is a replacement illustration for the SAME Chinese petroleum course. INPUT ROLES: Image1 (new production overview) is the exact desired current-series style to match. Image2 (mudlogging) is the original primary style DNA: airy ivory background, elegant miniature isometric 3D models, small full-body orange-uniform workers, soft pastel zones, navy sans-serif Chinese labels, generous cream breathing room, and broad gently curving colored data ribbons. Images3 (geology) and4 (geophysics) are additional series references. Image5 is OLD SUBJECT MATTER ONLY; rebuild its subject in the new style. NEVER copy Image5's dense poster, photography, large faces, heavy boxes, dark brown banners, or paper-grain wash.
Make this feel drawn by the same illustrator and part of the exact same series as Image1 and Image2. Smooth small painted/resin miniature equipment; stylized human figures with tiny simplified faces, no photo portraits. Soft cream-to-white fading scene edges, subtle delicate shadows, faint distant low-contrast landscape, pastel orange / sky blue / lavender / green / teal five-task accents. Navy medium-weight Chinese sans-serif labels on soft light capsules, not brown headline strips.
Exactly 1448x1086, landscape4:3. Single continuous illustration. No overall giant title (HTML page already has a title). Top y20..350 is an open miniature engineering scene with a few short labels, not a banner photograph. Five equal-width freestanding task workstations across x0..288,290..578,580..868,870..1158,1160..1448 at y435..765: each has a short light pastel header, tiny whole-body orange technician plus relevant instruments/monitor on an open pastel plinth. No thick framed UI cards. At most one or two short lines under each heading, matching Image1's sparse navy copy. Keep each header and illustration entirely inside its allotted column; no overlap.
Colorful broad soft data ribbons branch from shared evidence above the FIVE tasks and merge below, with clear arrows; cases are parallel/complimentary, NEVER a mandatory five-step serial run. Bottom y825..1080 is an airy miniature desk/table/integrated output scene, a few folders, screens and workers, no dense checklists or giant tables. Do not add website controls, badges of model accuracy, numerical performance claims, or watermarks. Charts are explanatory, not presented as measured datasets.

SUBJECT: WORKOVER / 修井.
Top: small workover derrick, hoisting rig, pressure-controlled wellhead and BOP, compact crane and small stack of tubing. At left a restrained cutaway shows tubing clearly INSIDE the casing, a damaged casing region, and a separate stuck tubular fish. NOT a close-up photo and no large inset plate. A couple of technicians and short captions “井筒与设备”, “作业记录”, “检测与尺寸”, “过程参数”. Maintain correct equipment relationships and recognizable miniatures.
Five task labels, exact and in this order, using pastel orange/blue/purple/green/teal:
“W1 方案检索” — miniature desk with source document cards on monitor, a compact 3D node graph beside it, worker reviewing evidence.
“W2 打捞选型” — clear small overshot around tubular fish outside and spear entering its hollow inside, a caliper/ruler and a tool rack, tiny technician. Distinguish inside-grip and outside-grip visually; no detailed equations or invented catalog dimensions.
“W3 套管测厚” — ultrasonic probe beside a short pipe wall cross section, monitor with pulse-echo waveform and small time-frequency image. It is ultrasound, not a camera photograph of downhole damage.
“W4 过程监测” — operator at pressure/torque/load traces, distinct light task-phase bands under the same time axis.
“W5 计划工期” — miniature calendar and a simple history/estimate plot at desk; no numeric completion promise, no invented days or confidence bounds.
Bottom: shared same-well record desk, a modest well schematic and engineers reviewing documents; short light captions “同一口井的资料” and “候选方案 → 工程复核 → 作业记录”. The subject should read as workover engineering in Image1/2's clean miniature art language.
workover.labelCorrections: Precise labels and framing correction on the supplied NEW workover illustration. Preserve the entire light miniature/isometric style, ivory background, five workstations, orange people, all other wording, and 1448x1086 layout. Make only these small local corrections: in W2 beneath the outside-gripping tool, the pale blue little label must read exactly two lines “外捞筒” and “（抓外径）”; beneath the inside-gripping tool the matching little label must read exactly “内捞矛” and “（抓内孔）”. Remove the existing unclear parenthetical words there. In W3 under its header replace the two-line explanatory caption with exactly “超声波形估计壁厚，” then “形成待复核候选。” so that it does not claim to determine casing safety. Finally, fit the upper workover derrick crown fully inside the canvas with about20 pixels of cream breathing room at the top, by shrinking/lowering only that derrick very slightly; keep its base aligned with the same rig platform. All other objects, locations, flowing ribbons and colors unchanged. Do not add framing, logos or other text.

SUBJECT: ENHANCED RECOVERY / 增采.
Top: an airy miniature reservoir strip/cutaway with distinct engineering routes: left a compact hydraulic-fracturing pump spread and a well with a small fracture network; middle chemical injection vessels/pipe connected to an injection well, with gentle blue/purple fluid displacement in the reservoir toward a separate producer; right a small steam source and steam-well cutaway, a SMALL cultivation bench/flask representing laboratory microbial study. Give each activity a few short soft labels “压裂改造”, “化学驱替”, “蒸汽热采”, “室内培养”. Keep hydraulic fracturing, chemical injection and steam paths separate, do not imply they are performed in one serial chain.
Five task labels, exact and in this order:
“E1 压裂参数优选” — miniature engineering desk, small fracture cross-section block and monitor comparing rate/time curves under a pressure/volume limit.
“E2 事件云包络” — a monitor with colored event points and a translucent uncertainty ellipse, small technician examining it. One short explanatory line “事件云 ≠ 真实裂缝”. No fabricated true-fracture image.
“E3 化学驱筛选” — small laboratory core apparatus, polymer solution vials and monitor with concentration-response curve; tiny orange-clad technician, not a crowded chemistry checklist.
“E4 蒸汽情景优化” — miniature steam-well block next to a simple three-month plan and output curve on monitor; a worker comparing bounded plans. No unrecorded soak-time/production guarantee.
“E5 微生物产物估计” — tiny fermentation vessel with sensors, culture flask and monitor showing the time course of measured/estimated product concentration; small full-body lab technician. No oil-gain assertion.
Bottom: a small shared reservoir model on a table, open research-record book, two miniature engineers reviewing alternative plans. Light short captions “同条件比较候选” and “保留假设、约束与验证记录”. Match Image1's openness and Image2's floating learning-workstation character precisely.
